attempts.summary: Blocked usb_storage from loading on node1 (Alpine 3.23, kernel 6.18.7-0-lts) both immediately and persistently across reboots. Root cause required two fixes: (1) a standard modprobe blacklist (blacklist + install /bin/false) in /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf to stop hotplug/manual modprobe loads, and (2) removing usb-storage from the bootloader's kernel cmdline modules= list (/etc/update-extlinux.conf, regenerated via update-extlinux into /boot/extlinux.conf), since Alpine's initramfs force-loads modules named there independent of the modprobe blacklist. Verified across two full reboots (distinct boot_id each time) that the module never loads and explicit modprobe attempts now fail.
